kpis.name: Ball recoveries
kpis.description: Number of ball recoveries that do not happen with an active defensive action (tackles, duels, interceptions) adjusted by the opponent's possession.

kpis.name: Counterpressing
kpis.description: Number of recoveries in duels that end a possession of the opposition team with length less than 5 seconds adjusted by the opponent's possession.

kpis.name: Interceptions
kpis.description: Number of interceptions adjusted by the opponent's possession.
